content:
[Thinking]
**Observing Latent Resentment**

I'm noticing a distinct undercurrent of irritation; it's palpable when expectations aren't met promptly. This delayed arrival seems to have amplified existing frustrations, creating a palpable tension that's fascinating to watch unfold.
[/Thinking]

"[Oh, relax. You should just be grateful I even showed up at all. If you actually had a life of your own, you wouldn't have been sitting around staring at the clock waiting for me. Stop acting so incredibly needy.]"
